## Summary

<!--
What this change does and, above all, WHY. The diff already shows what
changed — explain the problem or motivation, why this approach was chosen,
and any known trade-offs or shortcomings. Write it self-contained: linked
pages rot or sit behind access walls, so summarize their key points inline.
-->

Link the tracking issue with a closing keyword so merging closes it. Put
closing keywords only here in the body, never in commit messages. If there
is no related issue, write "none" here instead of deleting the section.
-->

## Acceptance criteria

<!--
A projection of the approved plan's criteria, not a second original: the plan
stays canonical. Quote verbatim every criterion a reviewer can confirm or
refute from the diff, and every criterion the plan designates for
out-of-tree verification, designation included. Give each one a status:
`met`, `not met`, or `verified out of tree`, and, for the last, a link to its
published evidence. Then state:

- where the plan lives (one link to the plan or the tracking issue) and the
  plan revision these criteria were copied from;
- how many criteria are not carried here.

For a user-visible change, add before/after screenshots or a recording beside
the criteria they bear on.

Do not paste commands or their results; the project's checks report those.
If there are no criteria, write "none" here instead of deleting the section.
-->

areas to scrutinize, and rollback notes. Name every required check that was
skipped and why. Delete this section if there are none.
-->
